newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Jan 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Jan 13.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
- Palestinians and Israelis surmounted the final obstacle to a Hebron agreement, the timetable for Israeli withdrawal from the West Bank.

- Weeks after calling for an end to almost all rent regulations, the Republican leader of the State Senate faces a potential revolt among some Republicans that could derail his plans for sweeping changes to the system.
- New York Governor George Pataki has proposed a plan to allow parents, teachers and community groups to create small schools financed by taxpayers but independent of local school boards.
- Tensions between Hasidic Jews and their secular neighbors in Rockland County, NY, have led in the last few years to bitter disputes over zoning laws and other matters.
